title_en: Renting a car: licence, insurance, fuel and damage
title_he: השכרת רכב: רישיון, ביטוח, דלק ונזקים

situation.en: You're picking up a rental car at Edinburgh Airport for a week in the Scottish Highlands. The agent checks your licence, offers extra insurance and explains the fuel policy. When you inspect the car, you notice a scratch that isn't on the damage form. A week later, at the return desk, there's a disagreement about a dent.
situation.he: אתם אוספים רכב שכור בשדה התעופה של אדינבורו לשבוע בהיילנדס הסקוטיים. הנציגה בודקת את הרישיון, מציעה ביטוח נוסף ומסבירה את מדיניות הדלק. כשאתם בודקים את הרכב, אתם מגלים שריטה שלא מופיעה בטופס הנזקים. שבוע אחר כך, בהחזרת הרכב, מתגלעת מחלוקת על מכה בדלת.

goal.en: Confirm your booking and documents, understand what the insurance covers before agreeing to extras, check the fuel policy, get existing damage recorded and handle a damage dispute calmly.
goal.he: לאשר את ההזמנה והמסמכים, להבין מה הביטוח מכסה לפני שמסכימים לתוספות, לברר את מדיניות הדלק, לוודא שנזק קיים נרשם ולהתמודד ברוגע עם מחלוקת על נזק.

phrases.en: Hi, I've got a booking under the name Cohen.
phrases.he: היי, יש לי הזמנה על שם כהן.
phrases.note: 'Booking' is more common in the UK, 'reservation' in the US; both are understood.

phrases.en: Here's my driving licence and passport.
Do I need an international driving permit?
What exactly does the basic insurance cover?
What's the excess if something happens?
phrases.he: מה גובה ההשתתפות העצמית אם קורה משהו?

phrases.en: What's the deductible on the basic coverage?
I think I'll stick with the basic cover, thanks.
phrases.he: נראה לי שאסתפק בכיסוי הבסיסי, תודה.

phrases.note: Full to full: you get the car with a full tank and bring it back full.

phrases.en: Does it take petrol or diesel?
phrases.he: הוא על בנזין או על סולר?

phrases.en: Is it a manual or an automatic?
There's a scratch on the rear bumper that isn't marked on the form.
phrases.he: יש שריטה על הפגוש האחורי שלא מסומנת בטופס.

phrases.en: Could you note that down, please? I'd like it on record.
phrases.he: אפשר לרשום את זה, בבקשה? חשוב לי שזה יתועד.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Hiya, welcome to Edinburgh. Have you got a booking with us?

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name Cohen. Here's my driving licence and passport.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Lovely, thanks. So that's a compact car for seven days. Would you like to add our premium cover? It reduces your excess to zero.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: What's the excess with the basic insurance?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: With basic cover, you'd pay the first thousand pounds of any damage.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: I see. And how much is the premium cover?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: It's an extra fifteen pounds a day.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: I think I'll stick with the basic cover, thanks. What's the fuel policy?

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: It's full to full, so please bring it back with a full tank, or there's a refuelling charge.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Got it. Oh, and before I drive off: there's a scratch on the rear bumper that isn't on the form.

model_dialogue.speaker: partner
model_dialogue.text: Thanks for pointing that out. I'll come and have a look and add it to the damage report.

model_dialogue.speaker: you
model_dialogue.text: Great. Could I have a copy of the updated form, please?

practice.partner: Can I see your driving licence, please? And will anyone else be driving?

options.text: Here. Why do you need to know who's driving? That's private.

feedback.en: This sounds suspicious and defensive. It isn't a private question: extra drivers usually have to be added to the rental agreement.
feedback.he: נשמע חשדני ומתגונן. זו לא שאלה פרטית: נהגים נוספים צריכים בדרך כלל להירשם בחוזה ההשכרה.

options.text: Sure, here you go. No, it'll just be me.

feedback.en: Natural and complete: you hand over the document and answer the question clearly.
feedback.he: טבעי ומלא: מוסרים את המסמך ועונים על השאלה בבירור.

options.text: Yes, here it is. Only I drive, because my partner doesn't have a licence.

feedback.en: Understandable, but 'Only I drive' sounds like a general habit, and the agent doesn't need the reason. For this rental, say 'It'll just be me' or 'I'll be the only driver'.
feedback.he: מובן, אבל Only I drive נשמע כמו הרגל כללי, והנציגה לא צריכה לשמוע את הסיבה. לגבי ההשכרה הזאת אומרים It'll just be me או I'll be the only driver.

model_replies: Sure, here you go. No, it'll just be me.
Here you are. I'll be the only driver.

practice.partner: I'd really recommend our premium cover. Without it, you'd pay the first £1,200 of any damage.

options.text: Thanks. What exactly does it cover? Are the tyres and windscreen included?

feedback.en: Asks for details before agreeing, which is exactly right with insurance. 'Tyres' and 'windscreen' are the British words (US: tires, windshield).
feedback.he: מבקש פרטים לפני שמסכימים, וזה בדיוק מה שצריך לעשות עם ביטוח. tyres ו-windscreen הן המילים הבריטיות (בארצות הברית: tires, windshield).

options.text: No thanks, I don't need it. I'm a very careful driver, and I've never had an accident.

feedback.en: A clear, acceptable answer, but careful driving doesn't stop other people from damaging the car, and you're accepting a big risk without asking a single question. It's worth checking what's covered first.
feedback.he: תשובה ברורה ולגיטימית, אבל נהיגה זהירה לא מונעת מאחרים לפגוע ברכב, ואתם לוקחים על עצמכם סיכון גדול בלי לשאול אף שאלה. כדאי לבדוק קודם מה הכיסוי כולל.

options.text: I don't want your insurance. You just want my money.

feedback.en: Accusing the agent is rude. Agents are often expected to offer extras; a calm 'No, thank you' or a clear question works much better.
feedback.he: להאשים את הנציגה זה גס. נציגים נדרשים לעיתים קרובות להציע תוספות; No, thank you רגוע או שאלה ברורה עובדים הרבה יותר טוב.

model_replies: Thanks. What exactly does it cover? Are the tyres and windscreen included?
Before I decide, could you tell me what it covers that the basic insurance doesn't?

practice.partner: It's full to full on this one. Any questions about the fuel?

options.text: What is full to full? I don't understand nothing.

feedback.en: Double negative: say 'I don't understand anything', or better, 'Sorry, what does full to full mean?'
feedback.he: שלילה כפולה: אומרים I don't understand anything, ועוד יותר טוב: Sorry, what does full to full mean?

options.text: Just one: does it take petrol or diesel?

feedback.en: Short and practical: this one question prevents an expensive mistake, putting the wrong fuel in the car. 'Does it take...' is the natural way to ask.
feedback.he: קצר ומעשי: השאלה הזאת מונעת טעות יקרה, תדלוק בדלק הלא נכון. Does it take... היא הדרך הטבעית לשאול.

feedback.en: Statement questions are common in speech, but you need 'back': 'So I bring it back full?' It's also worth asking about petrol or diesel.
feedback.he: שאלה בצורת משפט חיווי נפוצה בדיבור, אבל חסר back: So I bring it back full? וכדאי לשאול גם אם הרכב על בנזין או על סולר.

model_replies: Just one: does it take petrol or diesel?
So I need to bring it back with a full tank. Is there a petrol station near the airport?

practice.partner: Right, you're all set. Just sign here to confirm there's no damage apart from what's on the form.

options.text: Wait. I need to check the car first.

feedback.en: The right idea, but 'Wait' and 'I need to' sound a little sharp. 'Could I check the car first?' gets the same result more politely.
feedback.he: הרעיון נכון, אבל Wait ו-I need to נשמעים קצת חדים. Could I check the car first? משיג את אותו הדבר בנימוס.

options.text: Sure, the car is perfect, I'll sign.

feedback.en: Polite, but risky: you're confirming the car has no other damage without looking. Always check, and take photos, before you sign.
feedback.he: מנומס, אבל מסוכן: אתם מאשרים שאין נזק נוסף בלי להסתכל. תמיד בודקים ומצלמים לפני שחותמים.

options.text: Could I check the car before I sign? I'd just like to make sure everything's on the form.

feedback.en: Sensible and polite: you only sign after checking, and the reason sounds reasonable, not suspicious.
feedback.he: נבון ומנומס: חותמים רק אחרי בדיקה, וההסבר נשמע סביר ולא חשדני.

model_replies: Could I check the car before I sign? I'd just like to make sure everything's on the form.
Would you mind if I had a quick look at the car before I sign?

practice.partner: Is everything OK with the car?

options.text: Mostly, yes, but there's a scratch on the rear bumper that isn't on the form. Could you add it, please?

feedback.en: Says exactly where the damage is and what you want done about it.
feedback.he: אומר בדיוק איפה הנזק ומה אתם מבקשים לעשות.

feedback.en: 'Broke' is far too strong for a scratch and sounds dramatic. Describe it exactly: 'There's a small scratch on the rear bumper.'
feedback.he: broke חזק מדי לשריטה ונשמע דרמטי. מתארים בדיוק: There's a small scratch on the rear bumper.

feedback.en: Clear, but add where it is and what you'd like: 'Could you add it to the form, please?'
feedback.he: ברור, אבל כדאי להוסיף איפה בדיוק ומה אתם מבקשים: Could you add it to the form, please?

model_replies: Mostly, yes, but there's a scratch on the rear bumper that isn't on the form. Could you add it, please?
Almost. There's a small scratch here that isn't marked. Could you note it down?

practice.partner: We've found a dent on the passenger door, I'm afraid. We'll have to charge it to your card.

options.text: That's not my fault. It was there before.

feedback.en: Your point is clear, but it sounds defensive and gives no evidence. Mention the form or your photos.
feedback.he: הטענה ברורה, אבל נשמעת מתגוננת ואין בה ראיות. הזכירו את הטופס או את התמונות.

options.text: I'm sorry, but that dent was already there. It's on the damage form, and I've got photos.

feedback.en: Calm, firm and backed by evidence: exactly how to handle a dispute. 'I'm sorry, but...' signals polite disagreement.
feedback.he: רגוע, נחוש ומגובה בראיות: בדיוק כך מתמודדים עם מחלוקת. I'm sorry, but... מסמן אי-הסכמה מנומסת.

options.text: No way, I'm not paying anything. You're lying! You just want to take more money from tourists.

feedback.en: Calling the agent a liar and accusing the company of cheating tourists escalates the situation. Stay calm, show your proof and, if needed, ask to speak to a manager.
feedback.he: לקרוא לנציגה שקרנית ולהאשים את החברה שהיא מנצלת תיירים רק מסלים את המצב. נשארים רגועים, מציגים הוכחות, ואם צריך מבקשים לדבר עם מנהל.

model_replies: I'm sorry, but that dent was already there. It's on the damage form, and I've got photos.
I don't think that's right. The dent is marked on the pick-up form. Could we look at it together?

roleplay.persona: Fiona, a professional and slightly sales-focused rental agent at Edinburgh Airport. She's polite and efficient, speaks with a light Scottish accent ('Hiya', 'wee'), and is expected to sell extra insurance, so she'll recommend it more than once.
roleplay.complication: Fiona pushes the premium insurance and a paid upgrade, and the damage form she hands over is missing a scratch that's clearly visible on the car. The learner must ask clear questions, politely decline what they don't want and get the damage recorded before driving away.
roleplay.opening_line: Hiya, welcome to Edinburgh! Have you got a booking with us today?

culture.en: In the UK and Ireland, people drive on the left, and many rental cars are manual. If you can only drive an automatic, ask for one when you book.
culture.he: בבריטניה ובאירלנד נוהגים בצד שמאל של הכביש, ורכבים שכורים רבים הם ידניים. אם אתם נוהגים רק באוטומט, בקשו זאת כבר בהזמנה.

culture.en: Walk around the car and take photos or a short video before you leave and again when you return it. It's your best evidence if there's a disagreement about damage.
culture.he: הקיפו את הרכב וצלמו תמונות או סרטון קצר לפני היציאה ושוב בהחזרה. זו הראיה הכי טובה שלכם אם תהיה מחלוקת על נזק.

culture.en: Minimum age, international driving permits, deposits and insurance rules vary by company and country, so read the rental terms before you travel.
culture.he: גיל מינימלי, רישיון נהיגה בינלאומי, פיקדונות וכללי ביטוח משתנים בין חברות ומדינות, ולכן כדאי לקרוא את תנאי ההשכרה לפני הנסיעה.

variants.note: Both are understood in both countries.
